note: Yemen: Hong Kong SAR passports enter without a visa for 30 days; nationals of the Arab states listed and Malaysia get a visa on arrival for 3 months (Algeria 1); everyone else needs a visa from a Yemeni mission (the 2025 e-visa is for tour groups through accredited agencies only, not modelled). Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Yemen
sources.said: Holders of Hong Kong Special Administrative Region passport do not require a visa to enter Yemen, for a maximum stay of 30 days. ... Citizens of the following countries can obtain a visa on arrival in Yemen, valid for a maximum stay of 3 months (unless otherwise stated): Algeria (1 month) Bahrain Egypt Jordan Kuwait Malaysia Oman Qatar Saudi Arabia Syria United Arab Emirates
